unit: original paired observation identified by (record id, processed pair index); source pair index separately retained
full_roster: same input set of independent people, unchanged denominator; unavailable method is not exclusion
node_lookup: domain node integers index per-image node_lookup; processed order and source order are distinct
blocks: unordered partition of every local observation into exactly two nonempty groups; every outside original group remains fixed
forbidden_pairs: distance exceeds current metric threshold OR two observations belong to same worker; original coordinates stay intact
infeasible_partition_count: exact count from all unordered binary partitions minus all enumerated feasible partitions; individual invalid subsets encoded by forbidden-edge graph, not each stored as a separate row
cost: normalized pairwise dispersion W, not quality, probability, likelihood or support votes
edit_count: fewest changed block assignments after both old/new label alignments; equal alignments retained
selected_details: all automatic/assisted selected and Pareto candidates with centres and complete membership consequences
numerically_unique: unique after declared cost and 1e-10 numeric tie policy, no semantic uniqueness claim
diameters_deg_null: raw million-candidate ledger does not recompute this redundant statistic; feasibility certified by forbidden edges. Selected candidate files include directly checked diameters.
added_lost_coassignments: correspondence relationships changed, not source geometric edges; cannot be counted as visual corrections or errors without review
newly_split_identical_coordinates: distinct workers with identical paired coordinates now assigned to different identities; all votes/observations kept, semantic effect unknown
support: one observation per distinct worker in an identity, with unchanged full-pool denominator; no majority selection within this local study
center: periodic x and top/bottom coordinate medians conditional on a given grouping; tied anchors retained, not votes at the generated position
unb_bottom_support: geometric bottom group support; only the three stated human bottom identities tentatively reviewed
unb_geometric_support: upper geometry subgroup count, not a semantic label or verified top target
unb_original_pair_incidence: members of a semantic/unknown bucket retain original top-bottom relation; bottom marginal cannot be copied into joint incidence
unb_unknown: not a shared semantic target; no pooled semantic centre; original endpoints and geometric subgroup centres retained separately
source_rings: unchanged; no new x-sorted or other ring is generated
GT: not loaded; development windows historically exposed and not heldout
limits: two-block local domains only; conditional proof, no arbitrary multi-group or 2-vs3 local path correspondence; no visual adjudication
